title: diini qarik lakmisa rooci
intro: Qur'aanak galitteh addal, kaxxa nabiyyih gicloh addat, idaltuh acwa yeceen muuci yewqe. ta rooci yassakaxxeenim aggiriqqe sinni numma kee adda xer doori diini xisne too diini iffonta akkele. Atu xongoloola elle takriye innal, taturte xongolo cubbil ankacis, toh naharsi numul yabtaamih taagah.
clues: Anu Qur'aanak gersi nabiyyih xaqut galab kak xagem idaltuh yan farmoytih acwa kinniimi.
anu namma samadak numuk teynak suge too farmoytal kaak ellecaboh liggiditteh addat.
Anu inni qangaral numma liyoomuh Qur'aanal faatiteh.
Anu nabiyyi kunnabna quukak farmoyti akkuk ruube.
Anu yabba lih angaaraweh diini qarih rakiibo fayya haanama.
Anu sabri le marak numuk teyna kinniyom kassitah, nanu xisneh nan diini qari ummattah madaarah arac kee amaan le arac yekke.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Ibrahim lih kaaqbah rakiibo fayya haanama.
trial.answer: Ibrahim lih kaaqbah rakiibo fayya haanama.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
